terra.problem: The passage does not say the rebellion happened as soon as Jehoram became king or during his first week.
The passage says Mesha rebelled, but does not say the payments stopped.
The passage does not say whether there was paperwork or a handshake.
It identifies Jehoram and Joram as the same person without a verse that says so outright.
It identifies Joram and Jehoram as the same person without a verse that says so outright. The statement that the Wilderness of Zin is a biblical place also needs a reference.
The Wilderness of Zin and the Desert of Edom do not have names that sound a lot alike.
It identifies Joram and Jehoram as the same person without a verse that says so outright.
The passage says they had no water, but does not mention canteens.
The passage does not say the army or the animals complained about being thirsty.
The statement that priests served in God's house is a fact from outside the passage and needs a reference.
The king repeats the idea, but it is not the same line he said earlier.
Elisha refers to Jehoshaphat's presence, but the passage does not say he was standing next to the king of Israel.
The passage does not say the harpist played in the camp.
The passage does not say what anybody was expecting.
The LORD says they will not see wind or rain. The passage does not say there will be no clouds.
The passage does not say they went to sleep or woke up to find the water.
The passage says the water looked red to the Moabites; it does not say whether the water itself changed color.
The claim that clear water would have saved Moab trouble invents a consequence the passage does not give.
The passage does not say the Moabites ran toward the camp.
The passage says the Moabites saw the water across the way, not across a field.
The passage does not say the kings were fine.
The passage does not say the Moabites ran toward the plunder.
The passage does not say the Moabites expected an empty camp or whether they checked it before entering.
It says the words match, but verse 19 says “stop up” and verse 25 says “stopped up.”
